tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Find social media marketing agencies and freelancers in the directory. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Results are ordered by relevance to the query, then rating, then name. Returns a page of agency summaries with total, limit and offset for paging; call get_agency with a result's slu

tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: Full public profile of one agency: description, industries, team size, client focus, founded year, address, phone, social links, logo, review summary, and links to request a proposal or claim the listing. Takes the slug from search_agencies.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Countries with agencies, or, when a country is given, the cities in that country, each with its agency count and directory URL. Use the returned names or slugs as the country and city filters of search_agencies.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Service categories (for example Social Media Management, Paid Social Advertising, Influencer Marketing) with agency counts and directory URLs. Use the slug as the service filter of search_agencies. "Full-Service Digital" is a broad category.

tools.name: top_agencies
tools.description: The ranked Top 10 (or Top 5) agencies the directory's 2026 awards name for a city, best first. Cities without an award return an empty list and a note; use search_agencies for those.

tools.name: directory_stats
tools.description: Size and freshness of the directory: number of agencies, countries, cities and services, the date of the latest update, and links to how listings are verified and to the 2026 agency report.
